findings.evidence: "On PostgreSQL and MySQL use fixed-scale `NUMERIC`/`DECIMAL`, never floating point." and line 38 "Unique keys accept many NULLs in PostgreSQL, MySQL and SQLite."
findings.fix: Shorten the parts the model already knows to one clause each, for example "Money: exact types (SQLite: INTEGER minor units, because DECIMAL gets NUMERIC affinity and stores REAL)". Keep the engine-specific traps: SQLite affinity, Decimal128 and `NULLS NOT DISTINCT`.

findings.evidence: Workflow step 1 fits four questions, their engine branches and the full MongoDB embed-or-reference rule into one paragraph of about 130 words
findings.fix: Split step 1 into four sub-bullets (live data, tenant noun, atomic writes, hot reads), each giving its action. Move the embed-or-reference criteria into the MongoDB 16 MiB gotcha or a sub-bullet so the process pattern reads as discrete checkpoints.

findings.evidence: "files": [ "references/migrations.md" ] lists the skill's own reference as an eval input file, and the same happens in the review, MySQL and SQLite evals
findings.fix: Limit `files` to user-supplied inputs under `evals/files/`. Drop `references/migrations.md` and `references/schema-design-checklist.md` from `files`, so the with-skill and without-skill runs differ only by the skill. This also tests whether the skill's own load triggers fire.

findings.evidence: "`ON DELETE SET NULL` on a composite tenant FK also nulls the tenant column... On PostgreSQL 15+, write `ON DELETE SET NULL (assignee_id)`". The MySQL, SQLite and PostgreSQL <15 branch of a tenant model with a nullable assignee has no fallback, and `references/migrations.md` gives the composite-FK retrofit only for PostgreSQL
findings.fix: Add the fallback for other engines: "On MySQL, SQLite or PostgreSQL <15, use `ON DELETE RESTRICT` on the composite FK and clear `assignee_id` in the same transaction before deleting the user (or with a BEFORE DELETE trigger)." Add a MySQL note to the retrofit section: no `NOT VALID`, so clean bad rows first, then `ADD FOREIGN KEY` with `ALGORITHM=INPLACE, LOCK=NONE` under `foreign_key_checks=0` only after the orphan query returns zero rows.
